## Built to Last a Lifetime

![](https://www.roamluggage.com/cdn/shop/files/Frame_6346_784e699a-8b2b-4c0d-870f-06b3aa8a3504.png?v=1787257605&width=1200)

### Engineered for Durability

Our shells use 50% recycled polycarbonate and 50% virgin polycarbonate, selected for it's strength, impact resistance, and ability to retain its shape over time.

![](https://www.roamluggage.com/cdn/shop/files/Frame_6347.png?v=1787257618&width=1200)

### Effortless Rolling

Ball-bearing 360° spinner wheels are engineered to glide effortlessly from concourse to sidewalk and everywhere in between.

![](https://www.roamluggage.com/cdn/shop/files/Frame_6349.png?v=1787959523&width=1200)

### Stitched for Strength

Each case is stitched with military-grade T210 thread, using a lock stitch technique as strong as a 70-pound fishing line, while a recessed stitch channel helps protect the thread for added durability.

![ROAM Luggage](https://www.roamluggage.com/cdn/shop/files/Roam_Logo_White.png?v=1613701260&width=320)
